entities.name: Miguel Pedro Mundo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miguel Pedro Mundo was an American-born bishop of the Catholic Church in Brazil. In the Diocese of Jataí, he served as Auxiliary Bishop from 1978 to 1999, then Bishop of Jataí for the last three months of his life.
